Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.keys

Class NimbusSignedTokenService

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.keys.NimbusSignedTokenService
All Implemented Interfaces:
SignedTokenService
@Component public class NimbusSignedTokenService extends Object implements SignedTokenService
Issues and verifies purpose-bound tokens as JWTs signed with the active signing key and verified against the published keys. Verification checks the signature, the issuer, the timestamps and then the purpose; every failure is reported the same way, as an empty result.
